ethan: Quick handover for Sierra Health — signed on Thurs. Priya, please take primary CSM. Key bullets: SSO via Okta, EU data residency required, private VPC + peering, target steady-state 50 qps for first 3 months, renewal window ~9 months. Known risk: they need model determinism for clinical summaries, might request narrower model or eval hooks. Docs: https://redwood/docs/sierra-health (private).
priya: Got it — taking ownership. Can we confirm kickoff week? I have capacity next Tue/Wed. Who owns VPC setup and KMS? Also want list of initial success metrics.
ethan: Kickoff Tue 11am PT works. Maya (AM) will intro on procurement. Jon, can you own infra TODOs (peering + model pinning)?
maya-am: I’ll do the procurement intro in the kickoff and share contract SOW and approved model variants. Procurement note: their legal flagged data residency clause — legal is looped.
jon-se: I’ll open infra tickets. Need eng help for private deployment and model variant pinning (they want fc-short-1.0 for determinism). Expected tasks: 1) VPC peering + route tables, 2) KMS key grants, 3) deploy private control-plane package. ETA preliminary by EOW if no blockers.
ava-support: FYI support baseline: 24/5 for first 90 days; we should create runbook for incident escalation. Also recommend enabling request-level tracing and logs to S3 (retention 90d) per compliance.
priya: Suggested onboarding checklist for kickoff: - Intro + SOW review - SSO/Okta setup owner - Network/peering plan - Initial eval plan (5 prompts for clinical summary) - Success metrics: latency < 250ms P95, 50 qps baseline, error rate < 0.5% - Training session for their ML ops team
ethan: Adding renewal risk notes: upsell likely if enterprise metrics stable. Risk: if determinism / hallucination not acceptable, they may pause. Plan to run continuous evals and set regression alerts via Redwood Optimize.
jon-se: Infra ticket created: INF-5821 (private-deploy/sierra-health). Linking here: https://redwood/infra/INF-5821. Assigning to eng-platform and se-team.
infra-bot: INF-5821 created by jon-se and assigned to eng-platform. ETA label: expedited.
priya: I'll schedule Tue 11am kickoff and invite Maya, Jon, Ava, legal, and their technical lead (Elena). Agenda: SOW review, timelines, ownership, immediate blockers. Post-kickoff I'll open a CSM action tracker and share weekly cadence.
ethan: Thanks team. Owner summary: CSM=priya, SE=jon-se, AM=maya-am, Support=ava-support, Infra ticket=INF-5821. Next steps: kickoff invite, infra exec on peering, Okta SSO details, create onboarding tracker. :thumbsup:
ava-support: I’ll prepare the support runbook template and post it to the CS folder after kickoff.
priya: Noted. Will also capture customer feedback loop plan and add to weekly notes. Closing loop after kickoff with action items.
